name: Tent Pegs / Stakes
description: Guidelines for traveling with tent pegs / stakes in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Tent pegs and stakes are generally prohibited in carry-on baggage because they can be used as weapons, but they are fully allowed in checked luggage.
conditions: Tent poles must also be packed in checked baggage.
Ensure stakes are packed securely so they do not puncture checked bag walls.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring tent pegs / stakes on a plane?

travelTips: Tent poles must also be packed in checked baggage.

faq.question: Is tent pegs / stakes allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Tent Pegs / Stakes is not allowed in carry-on luggage. Tent pegs and stakes are generally prohibited in carry-on baggage because they can be used as weapons, but they are fully allowed in checked luggage.

faq.question: Can you pack tent pegs / stakes in checked baggage?
faq.answer: Yes, Tent Pegs / Stakes is allowed in checked bags.
